title: Clause fingerprinting + negotiation scoring to model price and risk impact for MSA/DPA redlines
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and Legal currently triage MSA/DPA redlines and indemnity/liability concessions manually. We lack a consistent way to quantify how specific clause edits affect price, indemnity exposure, and internal approval paths. This creates slow turnaround, inconsistent quotes, and hidden lift for Sales.

Proposal: Build a clause fingerprinting + negotiation scoring service that (1) extracts canonical clause types from uploaded contract redlines and security questionnaire items, (2) maps clause variants to a risk/priority fingerprint (liability cap changes, indemnity additions, data residency/KMS asks), and (3) returns a structured negotiation score and suggested price uplift or concession bucket. Integrate output into the Quote UI and Legal intake to power auto-routing, estimated margin impact, and suggested approval paths.

Scope: MVP focuses on MSA/DPA clauses and commonly requested indemnity/liability exceptions. We will not attempt to auto-redline language beyond tagging and scoring. MVP outputs are: clause fingerprints, score (0-100), suggested concession bucket (none/standard/high/exec), and estimated list price uplift percentage range.

Goals:
- Reduce average contract review TTR for mid-market deals by 30% for flagged clauses.
- Provide Sales with an estimated price adjustment for common concession buckets at point of quote.
- Create telemetry to measure how clause scores correlate with eventual concessions taken.

Non-goals: Full legal automation, binding pricing decisions without legal sign-off.
acceptance_criteria: Service can parse uploaded MSA/DPA redline (text or PDF->OCR) and return a list of detected clause types with normalized fingerprints.
Each clause fingerprint includes a risk tag (low/medium/high), numeric negotiation score (0-100), and mapped concession bucket (none/standard/high/exec).
Frontend shows clause summary, score, and suggested price uplift (%) in the Quote preview for Sales users behind a feature flag.
Telemetry dashboard shows distribution of clause scores, # of routed escalations, and realized price uplift vs suggested uplift for initial 6-week experiment.
Legal intake routing is triggered for scores above threshold and creates a pre-populated review ticket with highlighted clauses and suggested approval path.
Prototype documentation (confluence) and legal sign-off obtained for fingerprint taxonomy and scoring heuristics prior to rollout.
Security review completed for document ingestion and temporary storage of redlines (KMS usage and retention policy enforced).
